Subject: Invitation: Finova as Customer Ambassador — short co-hosted webinar

Hi Samir,

Hope you’re well — we really appreciated the product overview you shared with our engineering team last quarter. We’re putting together a short, customer-focused webinar series (30 minutes + 10 Q&A) that highlights how companies are using Redwood Inference to reduce inference costs and improve latency in production. I wanted to see if Finova would be interested in joining as a customer ambassador for one of the episodes.

High-level proposal:
- Date: week of Feb 22 — we’re tentatively targeting Feb 25 at 10:00 AM PT (can change)
- Format: 20-min conversation (product/practical lessons) + 10-min live Q&A
- Audience: mix of engineering leads and product managers; joint promotion with CloudConf and our partner channels

We’ll handle promo, slide production, and registrant outreach. Attached: a one-page proposed agenda and a speaker bio template to make this easy.

Quick asks if you’re open:
1) Would you be willing to present as the Finova customer lead?
2) If yes, can you send a one-paragraph bio + headshot and any must-have brand guidance?

We’re also happy to cover travel or speaker honoraria if that helps — happy to discuss.

Thanks — let me know and we’ll follow up with logistics.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Director, Customer Programs
Redwood Inference
